title: RBACv2 audit enrichment, SSO mapping consistency check, and operator guardrails
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: As we migrate customers from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 we need stronger audit fidelity and SSO/SAML mapping validation so operators and customers can confidently verify entitlement correctness. This ticket coordinates the dual-write/backfill strategy with audit enrichment (attach SAML assertion metadata and admin-action provenance), an automated consistency checker for SSO mappings, and operator guardrails (alerts, safe rollback paths, and runbooks).
description_detail:
Goals:
- Ensure every permission mutation (create/update/delete) produced during dual-write includes an immutable audit envelope: actor ID, SSO assertion fingerprint, source version (v1/v2), operation correlation id, and timestamp.
- Build an SSO mapping sanity checker that validates NameID/email/email_verified claims map to the same internal principal across v1 and v2 for canary orgs.
- Implement a reconciler that runs incremental backfills based on delta streams (idempotent replays) and surfaces divergence metrics.
- Provide operator guardrails: action gating for mass backfills, automated snapshot + rollback plan, and severity-rated alerts for divergent states.
Success criteria:
- For 5 pilot customers, dual-write traffic shows <= 1% structural divergence after 48h and all divergences have triageable root causes.
- Audit entries for mutated permissions include SSO fingerprint and operation correlation id in 100% of dual-write cases.
- Console exposes a per-org divergence score and a playbook link that allows on-call to trigger safe rollback or targeted replay.
Scope in this ticket:
- Schema additions to audit envelope and migration of write paths to include enrichment headers.
- Lightweight SSO mapping checker service and a plan to run it as a canary for selected orgs.
- Telemetry dashboards and alerts; a basic reconciler for incremental replay and a human-reviewed rollback path.
Out of scope:
- Full-scale backfill for all customers (handled by separate bulk-backfill project).
- New RBAC policy language changes.
implementation_notes:
Engineering approach:
1) Add audit envelope fields to write APIs (headers accepted for dual-write path) with defensive parsing and feature flag gating.
2) Introduce an SSO fingerprint computed from canonicalized NameID and assertion attributes; store fingerprint as part of audit record.
3) Dual-write behavior: v1 writes remain unchanged; v2 writes include envelope. A sidecar reconciler subscribes to change streams and computes diffs.
4) Reconciler produces a per-org divergence report and a small set of remediation actions (replay, escalate, mark-for-manual-review).
5) Alerts: divergence-rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m -> P0 alert; failed backfill job -> P1.
Operational safety:
- Feature-flag default: off. Enable per-org for pilots only.
- Canaries: start with 3 non-critical orgs, expand to 5 pilot customers.
- Bookend every mass operation with snapshot and idempotent rollback token.
- Documented runbook with step-by-step comms templates for customers.
qa_plan:
- Unit tests for audit envelope serialization and SSO fingerprinting.
- Integration tests exercising dual-write and reconciler with synthetic orgs.
- SSO mapping checker fuzz tests on varied assertion shapes.
- End-to-end canary: enable for org, perform scripted role changes, and validate reconciliation and audit entries appear in console.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1: internal canary (engineering orgs) with feature flag on, run reconciler for 72h.
Phase 2: 3 pilot customers with SRE on-call and on-call playbook in place.
Phase 3: Expand to 20 pilot orgs if divergence <1% and no P0 incidents.
Phase 4: schedule bulk backfill project handoff or wide activation.
rollback_plan:
- Immediate: flip feature flag off for org to stop v2 enrichment writes.
- Reconciler provides snapshot id to restore previous role state if wide divergence detected.
- Communication: customer-facing notice template stored in Confluence; incident postmortem required for any rollback.
customer_comms: Templates: initial pilot invite, mid-canary status update, action-required notice if we detect annotated divergence. Links included to customer-facing audit sample and steps to opt-out. Example PRD/comm templates linked in Confluence.
